summary.text: Jordan Harris is a Democratic member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives for District 186, which he has represented since December 2012, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Harris earned a B.A. in Government & Political Affairs from Millersville University in 2006 and an M.Ed. from Cabrini College in 2008.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as educator.
Harris assumed office in the House on December 1, 2012.
In the 2023-2024 session he was assigned to the Appropriations Committee, as chair, and the Rules Committee.
